verses.en: And he heard the words of Laban’s sons, saying, Jacob hath taken away all that was our father’s; and of that which was our father’s hath he gotten all this glory.
verses.pt: E ouvia ele as palavras dos filhos de Labão que diziam: Jacó tomou tudo o que era de nosso pai; e do que era de nosso pai adquiriu toda esta grandeza.
verses.en_web: He heard the words of Laban’s sons, saying, “Jacob has taken away all that was our father’s. He has obtained all this wealth from that which was our father’s.”
verses.en_bbe: Now it came to the ears of Jacob that Laban's sons were saying, Jacob has taken away all our father's property, and in this way he has got all this wealth.

verses.en: And Jacob beheld the countenance of Laban, and, behold, it was not toward him as before.
verses.pt: Olhava também Jacó o semblante de Labão, e via que não era para com ele como antes.
verses.en_web: Jacob saw the expression on Laban’s face, and, behold, it was not toward him as before.
verses.en_bbe: And Jacob saw that Laban's feeling for him was no longer what it had been before.

verses.en: And the LORD said unto Jacob, Return unto the land of thy fathers, and to thy kindred; and I will be with thee.
verses.pt: Também o SENHOR disse a Jacó: Volta-te à terra de teus pais, e à tua parentela; que eu serei contigo.
verses.en_web: Yahweh said to Jacob, “Return to the land of your fathers, and to your relatives, and I will be with you.”
verses.en_bbe: Then the Lord said to Jacob, Go back to the land of your fathers, and to your relations, and I will be with you.

verses.en: And Jacob sent and called Rachel and Leah to the field unto his flock,
verses.pt: E enviou Jacó, e chamou a Raquel e a Lia ao campo a suas ovelhas,
verses.en_web: Jacob sent and called Rachel and Leah to the field to his flock,
verses.en_bbe: And Jacob sent for Rachel and Leah to come to him in the field among his flock.

verses.en: And said unto them, I see your father’s countenance, that it is not toward me as before; but the God of my father hath been with me.
verses.pt: E disse-lhes: Vejo que o semblante de vosso pai não é para comigo como antes: mas o Deus de meu pai tem sido comigo.
verses.en_web: and said to them, “I see the expression on your father’s face, that it is not toward me as before; but the God of my father has been with me.
verses.en_bbe: And he said to them, It is clear to me that your father's feeling is no longer what it was to me; but the God of my father has been with me

verses.en: And ye know that with all my power I have served your father.
verses.pt: E vós sabeis que com todas minhas forças servi a vosso pai:
verses.en_web: You know that I have served your father with all of my strength.
verses.en_bbe: And you have seen how I have done all in my power for your father,

verses.en: And your father hath deceived me, and changed my wages ten times; but God suffered him not to hurt me.
verses.pt: E vosso pai me enganou, e me mudou o salário dez vezes: mas Deus não lhe permitiu que me fizesse mal.
verses.en_web: Your father has deceived me, and changed my wages ten times, but God didn’t allow him to hurt me.
verses.en_bbe: But your father has not kept faith with me, and ten times he has made changes in my payment; but God has kept him from doing me damage.

verses.en: If he said thus, The speckled shall be thy wages; then all the cattle bare speckled: and if he said thus, The ringstraked shall be thy hire; then bare all the cattle ringstraked.
verses.pt: Se ele dizia assim: Os pintados serão teu salário; então todas as ovelhas geravam pintados: e se dizia assim: Os listrados serão teu salário; então todas as ovelhas geravam listrados.
verses.en_web: If he said this, ‘The speckled will be your wages,’ then all the flock bore speckled. If he said this, ‘The streaked will be your wages,’ then all the flock bore streaked.
verses.en_bbe: If he said, All those in the flock which have marks are to be yours, then all the flock gave birth to marked young; and if he said, All the banded ones are to be yours, then all the flock had banded young.

verses.en: Thus God hath taken away the cattle of your father, and given them to me.
verses.pt: Assim tirou Deus o gado de vosso pai, e deu-o a mim.
verses.en_web: Thus God has taken away your father’s livestock, and given them to me.
verses.en_bbe: So God has taken away your father's cattle and has given them to me.

verses.en: And it came to pass at the time that the cattle conceived, that I lifted up mine eyes, and saw in a dream, and, behold, the rams which leaped upon the cattle were ringstraked, speckled, and grisled.
verses.pt: E sucedeu que ao tempo que as ovelhas se aqueciam, levantei eu meus olhos e vi em sonhos, e eis que os machos que cobriam às fêmeas eram listrados, pintados e malhados.
verses.en_web: During mating season, I lifted up my eyes, and saw in a dream, and behold, the male goats which leaped on the flock were streaked, speckled, and grizzled.
verses.en_bbe: And at the time when the flock were with young, I saw in a dream that all the he-goats which were joined with the she-goats were banded and marked and coloured.

verses.en: And the angel of God spake unto me in a dream, saying, Jacob: And I said, Here am I.
verses.pt: E disse-me o anjo de Deus em sonhos: Jacó. E eu disse: Eis-me aqui.
verses.en_web: The angel of God said to me in the dream, ‘Jacob,’ and I said, ‘Here I am.’
verses.en_bbe: And in my dream the angel of the Lord said to me, Jacob: and I said, Here am I.

verses.en: And he said, Lift up now thine eyes, and see, all the rams which leap upon the cattle are ringstraked, speckled, and grisled: for I have seen all that Laban doeth unto thee.
verses.pt: E ele disse: Levanta agora teus olhos, e verás todos os machos que cobrem às ovelhas são listrados, pintados e malhados; porque eu vi tudo o que Labão te fez.
verses.en_web: He said, ‘Now lift up your eyes, and behold, all the male goats which leap on the flock are streaked, speckled, and grizzled, for I have seen all that Laban does to you.
verses.en_bbe: And he said, See how all the he-goats are banded and marked and coloured: for I have seen what Laban has done to you.

verses.en: I am the God of Bethel, where thou anointedst the pillar, and where thou vowedst a vow unto me: now arise, get thee out from this land, and return unto the land of thy kindred.
verses.pt: Eu sou o Deus de Betel, onde tu ungiste a coluna, e onde me fizeste um voto. Levanta-te agora, e sai desta terra, e volta-te à terra de teu nascimento.
verses.en_web: I am the God of Bethel, where you anointed a pillar, where you vowed a vow to me. Now arise, get out from this land, and return to the land of your birth.’”
verses.en_bbe: I am the God of Beth-el, where you put oil on the pillar and took an oath to me: now then, come out of this land and go back to the country of your birth.

verses.en: And Rachel and Leah answered and said unto him, Is there yet any portion or inheritance for us in our father’s house?
verses.pt: E respondeu Raquel e Lia, e disseram-lhe: Temos ainda parte ou herança na casa de nosso pai?
verses.en_web: Rachel and Leah answered him, “Is there yet any portion or inheritance for us in our father’s house?
verses.en_bbe: Then Rachel and Leah said to him in answer, What part or heritage is there for us in our father's house?

verses.en: Are we not counted of him strangers? for he hath sold us, and hath quite devoured also our money.
verses.pt: Não nos tem já como por estranhas, pois que nos vendeu, e ainda consumiu de todo nosso valor?
verses.en_web: Aren’t we considered as foreigners by him? For he has sold us, and has also used up our money.
verses.en_bbe: Are we not as people from a strange country to him? for he took a price for us and now it is all used up.

verses.en: For all the riches which God hath taken from our father, that is ours, and our children’s: now then, whatsoever God hath said unto thee, do.
verses.pt: Porque toda a riqueza que Deus tirou a nosso pai, nossa é e de nossos filhos: agora, pois, faze tudo o que Deus te disse.
verses.en_web: For all the riches which God has taken away from our father, that is ours and our children’s. Now then, whatever God has said to you, do.”
verses.en_bbe: For the wealth which God has taken from him is ours and our children's; so now, whatever God has said to you, do.

verses.en: Then Jacob rose up, and set his sons and his wives upon camels;
verses.pt: Então se levantou Jacó, e subiu seus filhos e suas mulheres sobre os camelos.
verses.en_web: Then Jacob rose up, and set his sons and his wives on the camels,
verses.en_bbe: Then Jacob put his wives and his sons on camels;

verses.en: And he carried away all his cattle, and all his goods which he had gotten, the cattle of his getting, which he had gotten in Padan-aram, for to go to Isaac his father in the land of Canaan.
verses.pt: E pôs em caminho todo seu gado, e todos os seus pertences que havia adquirido, o gado de seu ganho que havia obtido em Padã-Arã, para voltar-se a Isaque seu pai na terra de Canaã.
verses.en_web: and he took away all his livestock, and all his possessions which he had gathered, including the livestock which he had gained in Paddan Aram, to go to Isaac his father, to the land of Canaan.
verses.en_bbe: And sending on before him all his cattle and his property which he had got together in Paddan-aram, he made ready to go to Isaac his father in the land of Canaan.

verses.en: And Laban went to shear his sheep: and Rachel had stolen the images that were her father’s.
verses.pt: E Labão havia ido tosquiar suas ovelhas; e Raquel furtou os ídolos de seu pai.
verses.en_web: Now Laban had gone to shear his sheep: and Rachel stole the teraphim that were her father’s.
verses.en_bbe: Now Laban had gone to see to the cutting of the wool of his sheep; so Rachel secretly took the images of the gods of her father's house.

verses.en: And Jacob stole away unawares to Laban the Syrian, in that he told him not that he fled.
verses.pt: E enganou Jacó o coração de Labão arameu, em não lhe fazer saber que se fugia.
verses.en_web: Jacob deceived Laban the Syrian, in that he didn’t tell him that he was running away.
verses.en_bbe: And Jacob went away secretly, without giving news of his flight to Laban the Aramaean.

verses.en: So he fled with all that he had; and he rose up, and passed over the river, and set his face toward the mount Gilead.
verses.pt: Fugiu, pois, com tudo o que tinha; e levantou-se, e passou o rio, e pôs seu rosto ao monte de Gileade.
verses.en_web: So he fled with all that he had. He rose up, passed over the River, and set his face toward the mountain of Gilead.
verses.en_bbe: So he went away with all he had, and went across the River in the direction of the hill-country of Gilead.

verses.en: And it was told Laban on the third day that Jacob was fled.
verses.pt: E foi dito a Labão ao terceiro dia como Jacó havia fugido.
verses.en_web: Laban was told on the third day that Jacob had fled.
verses.en_bbe: And on the third day Laban had news of Jacob's flight.

verses.en: And he took his brethren with him, and pursued after him seven days’ journey; and they overtook him in the mount Gilead.
verses.pt: Então tomou a seus irmãos consigo, e foi atrás dele caminho de sete dias, e alcançou-lhe no monte de Gileade.
verses.en_web: He took his relatives with him, and pursued him seven days’ journey. He overtook him in the mountain of Gilead.
verses.en_bbe: And taking the men of his family with him, he went after him for seven days and overtook him in the hill-country of Gilead.

verses.en: And God came to Laban the Syrian in a dream by night, and said unto him, Take heed that thou speak not to Jacob either good or bad.
verses.pt: E veio Deus a Labão arameu em sonhos aquela noite, e lhe disse: Guarda-te que não fales a Jacó descomedidamente.
verses.en_web: God came to Laban, the Syrian, in a dream of the night, and said to him, “Be careful that you don’t speak to Jacob either good or bad.”
verses.en_bbe: Then God came to Laban in a dream by night, and said to him, Take care that you say nothing good or bad to Jacob.

verses.en: Then Laban overtook Jacob. Now Jacob had pitched his tent in the mount: and Laban with his brethren pitched in the mount of Gilead.
verses.pt: Alcançou, pois, Labão a Jacó, e este havia fixado sua tenda no monte: e Labão pôs a sua com seus irmãos no monte de Gileade.
verses.en_web: Laban caught up with Jacob. Now Jacob had pitched his tent in the mountain, and Laban with his relatives encamped in the mountain of Gilead.
verses.en_bbe: Now when Laban overtook him, Jacob had put up his tent in the hill-country; and Laban and his brothers put up their tents in the hill-country of Gilead.

verses.en: And Laban said to Jacob, What hast thou done, that thou hast stolen away unawares to me, and carried away my daughters, as captives taken with the sword?
verses.pt: E disse Labão a Jacó: Que fizeste, que me furtaste o coração, e trouxeste a minhas filhas como prisioneiras de guerra?
verses.en_web: Laban said to Jacob, “What have you done, that you have deceived me, and carried away my daughters like captives of the sword?
verses.en_bbe: And Laban said to Jacob, Why did you go away secretly, taking my daughters away like prisoners of war?

verses.en: Wherefore didst thou flee away secretly, and steal away from me; and didst not tell me, that I might have sent thee away with mirth, and with songs, with tabret, and with harp?
verses.pt: Por que te escondeste para fugir, e me furtaste, e não me deste notícia, para que eu te enviasse com alegria e com cantares, com tamborim e harpa?
verses.en_web: Why did you flee secretly, and deceive me, and didn’t tell me, that I might have sent you away with mirth and with songs, with tambourine and with harp;
verses.en_bbe: Why did you make a secret of your flight, not giving me word of it, so that I might have sent you away with joy and songs, with melody and music?

verses.en: And hast not suffered me to kiss my sons and my daughters? thou hast now done foolishly in so doing.
verses.pt: Que ainda não me deixaste beijar meus filhos e minhas filhas. Agora loucamente fizeste.
verses.en_web: and didn’t allow me to kiss my sons and my daughters? Now have you done foolishly.
verses.en_bbe: You did not even let me give a kiss to my sons and my daughters. This was a foolish thing to do.

verses.en: It is in the power of my hand to do you hurt: but the God of your father spake unto me yesternight, saying, Take thou heed that thou speak not to Jacob either good or bad.
verses.pt: Poder há em minha mão para fazer-vos mal; mas o Deus de vosso pai me falou de noite dizendo: Guarda-te que não fales a Jacó descomedidamente.
verses.en_web: It is in the power of my hand to hurt you, but the God of your father spoke to me last night, saying, ‘Be careful that you don’t speak to Jacob either good or bad.’
verses.en_bbe: It is in my power to do you damage: but the God of your father came to me this night, saying, Take care that you say nothing good or bad to Jacob.

verses.en: And now, though thou wouldest needs be gone, because thou sore longedst after thy father’s house, yet wherefore hast thou stolen my gods?
verses.pt: E já que te ias, porque tinhas saudade da casa de teu pai, por que me furtaste meus deuses?
verses.en_web: Now, you want to be gone, because you greatly longed for your father’s house, but why have you stolen my gods?”
verses.en_bbe: And now, it seems, you are going because your heart's desire is for your father's house; but why have you taken my gods?

verses.en: And Jacob answered and said to Laban, Because I was afraid: for I said, Peradventure thou wouldest take by force thy daughters from me.
verses.pt: E Jacó respondeu, e disse a Labão: Pois tive medo; porque disse, que talvez me tirasse à força tuas filhas.
verses.en_web: Jacob answered Laban, “Because I was afraid, for I said, ‘Lest you should take your daughters from me by force.’
verses.en_bbe: And Jacob, in answer, said to Laban, My fear was that you might take your daughters from me by force.

verses.en: With whomsoever thou findest thy gods, let him not live: before our brethren discern thou what is thine with me, and take it to thee. For Jacob knew not that Rachel had stolen them.
verses.pt: Em quem achares teus deuses, não viva: diante de nossos irmãos reconhece o que eu tiver teu, e leva-o. Jacó não sabia que Raquel havia os furtado.
verses.en_web: Anyone you find your gods with shall not live. Before our relatives, discern what is yours with me, and take it.” For Jacob didn’t know that Rachel had stolen them.
verses.en_bbe: As for your gods, if anyone of us has them, let him be put to death: make search before us all for what is yours, and take it. For Jacob had no knowledge that Rachel had taken them.

verses.en: And Laban went into Jacob’s tent, and into Leah’s tent, and into the two maidservants’ tents; but he found them not. Then went he out of Leah’s tent, and entered into Rachel’s tent.
verses.pt: E entrou Labão na tenda de Jacó, e na tenda de Lia, e na tenda das duas servas, e não os achou, e saiu da tenda de Lia, e veio à tenda de Raquel.
verses.en_web: Laban went into Jacob’s tent, into Leah’s tent, and into the tent of the two female servants; but he didn’t find them. He went out of Leah’s tent, and entered into Rachel’s tent.
verses.en_bbe: So Laban went into Jacob's tent and into Leah's tent, and into the tents of the two servant-women, but they were not there; and he came out of Leah's tent and went into Rachel's.

verses.en: Now Rachel had taken the images, and put them in the camel’s furniture, and sat upon them. And Laban searched all the tent, but found them not.
verses.pt: E tomou Raquel os ídolos, e os pôs em uma albarda de um camelo, e sentou-se sobre eles: e provou Labão toda a tenda e não os achou.
verses.en_web: Now Rachel had taken the teraphim, put them in the camel’s saddle, and sat on them. Laban felt around all the tent, but didn’t find them.
verses.en_bbe: Now Rachel had taken the images, and had put them in the camels' basket, and was seated on them. And Laban, searching through all the tent, did not come across them.

verses.en: And she said to her father, Let it not displease my lord that I cannot rise up before thee; for the custom of women is upon me. And he searched, but found not the images.
verses.pt: E ela disse a seu pai: Não se ire meu senhor, porque não me posso levantar diante de ti; pois estou com o costume das mulheres. E ele buscou, mas não achou os ídolos.
verses.en_web: She said to her father, “Don’t let my lord be angry that I can’t rise up before you; for I’m having my period.” He searched, but didn’t find the teraphim.
verses.en_bbe: And she said to her father, Let not my lord be angry because I do not get up before you, for I am in the common condition of women. And with all his searching, he did not come across the images.

verses.en: And Jacob was wroth, and chode with Laban: and Jacob answered and said to Laban, What is my trespass? what is my sin, that thou hast so hotly pursued after me?
verses.pt: Então Jacó se irou, e brigou com Labão; e respondeu Jacó e disse a Labão: Que transgressão é a minha? Qual é meu pecado, que com tanto ardor vieste a me perseguir?
verses.en_web: Jacob was angry, and argued with Laban. Jacob answered Laban, “What is my trespass? What is my sin, that you have hotly pursued me?
verses.en_bbe: Then Jacob was angry with Laban, and said, What crime or sin have I done that you have come after me with such passion?

verses.en: Whereas thou hast searched all my stuff, what hast thou found of all thy household stuff? set it here before my brethren and thy brethren, that they may judge betwixt us both.
verses.pt: Depois que apalpaste todos os meus móveis, acaso achaste algum dos objetos de tua casa? Põe-o aqui diante de meus irmãos e teus, e julguem entre nós ambos.
verses.en_web: Now that you have felt around in all my stuff, what have you found of all your household stuff? Set it here before my relatives and your relatives, that they may judge between us two.
verses.en_bbe: Now that you have made search through all my goods, what have you seen which is yours? Make it clear now before my people and your people, so that they may be judges between us.

verses.en: This twenty years have I been with thee; thy ewes and thy she goats have not cast their young, and the rams of thy flock have I not eaten.
verses.pt: Estes vinte anos estive contigo; tuas ovelhas e tuas cabras nunca abortaram, nem eu comi carneiro de tuas ovelhas.
verses.en_web: “These twenty years I have been with you. Your ewes and your female goats have not cast their young, and I haven’t eaten the rams of your flocks.
verses.en_bbe: These twenty years I have been with you; your sheep and your goats have had young without loss, not one of your he-goats have I taken for food.

verses.en: That which was torn of beasts I brought not unto thee; I bare the loss of it; of my hand didst thou require it, whether stolen by day, or stolen by night.
verses.pt: Nunca te trouxe o arrebatado pelas feras; eu pagava o dano; o furtado tanto de dia como de noite, de minha mão o exigias.
verses.en_web: That which was torn of animals, I didn’t bring to you. I bore its loss. Of my hand you required it, whether stolen by day or stolen by night.
verses.en_bbe: Anything which was wounded by beasts I did not take to you, but myself made up for the loss of it; you made me responsible for whatever was taken by thieves, by day or by night.

verses.en: Thus I was; in the day the drought consumed me, and the frost by night; and my sleep departed from mine eyes.
verses.pt: De dia me consumia o calor, e de noite a geada, e o sono se fugia de meus olhos.
verses.en_web: This was my situation: in the day the drought consumed me, and the frost by night; and my sleep fled from my eyes.
verses.en_bbe: This was my condition, wasted by heat in the day and by the bitter cold at night; and sleep went from my eyes.

verses.en: Thus have I been twenty years in thy house; I served thee fourteen years for thy two daughters, and six years for thy cattle: and thou hast changed my wages ten times.
verses.pt: Assim estive vinte anos em tua casa: catorze anos te servi por tuas duas filhas, e seis anos por teu gado; e mudaste meu salário dez vezes.
verses.en_web: These twenty years I have been in your house. I served you fourteen years for your two daughters, and six years for your flock, and you have changed my wages ten times.
verses.en_bbe: These twenty years I have been in your house; I was your servant for fourteen years because of your daughters, and for six years I kept your flock, and ten times was my payment changed.

verses.en: Except the God of my father, the God of Abraham, and the fear of Isaac, had been with me, surely thou hadst sent me away now empty. God hath seen mine affliction and the labour of my hands, and rebuked thee yesternight.
verses.pt: Se o Deus de meu pai, o Deus de Abraão, e o temor de Isaque, não fossem comigo, certamente me enviarias agora vazio; Deus viu minha aflição e o trabalho de minhas mãos, e repreendeu-te de noite.
verses.en_web: Unless the God of my father, the God of Abraham, and the fear of Isaac, had been with me, surely now you would have sent me away empty. God has seen my affliction and the labor of my hands, and rebuked you last night.”
verses.en_bbe: If the God of my father, the God of Abraham and the Fear of Isaac, had not been with me, you would have sent me away with nothing in my hands. But God has seen my troubles and the work of my hands, and this night he kept you back.

verses.en: And Laban answered and said unto Jacob, These daughters are my daughters, and these children are my children, and these cattle are my cattle, and all that thou seest is mine: and what can I do this day unto these my daughters, or unto their children which they have born?
verses.pt: E respondeu Labão, e disse a Jacó: As filhas são filhas minhas, e os filhos, filhos meus são, e as ovelhas são minhas ovelhas, e tudo o que tu vês é meu; e que posso eu fazer hoje a estas minhas filhas, ou a seus filhos que elas geraram?
verses.en_web: Laban answered Jacob, “The daughters are my daughters, the children are my children, the flocks are my flocks, and all that you see is mine: and what can I do today to these my daughters, or to their children whom they have borne?
verses.en_bbe: Then Laban, answering, said, These women are my daughters and these children my children, the flocks and all you see are mine: what now may I do for my daughters and for their children?

verses.en: Now therefore come thou, let us make a covenant, I and thou; and let it be for a witness between me and thee.
verses.pt: Vem, pois, agora, façamos aliança eu e tu; e seja em testemunho entre mim e ti.
verses.en_web: Now come, let us make a covenant, you and I; and let it be for a witness between me and you.”
verses.en_bbe: Come, let us make an agreement, you and I; and let it be for a witness between us.

verses.en: And Jacob took a stone, and set it up for a pillar.
verses.pt: Então Jacó tomou uma pedra, e levantou-a por coluna.
verses.en_web: Jacob took a stone, and set it up for a pillar.
verses.en_bbe: Then Jacob took a stone and put it up as a pillar.

verses.en: And Jacob said unto his brethren, Gather stones; and they took stones, and made an heap: and they did eat there upon the heap.
verses.pt: E disse Jacó a seus irmãos: Recolhei pedras. E tomaram pedras e fizeram um amontoado; e comeram ali sobre aquele amontoado.
verses.en_web: Jacob said to his relatives, “Gather stones.” They took stones, and made a heap. They ate there by the heap.
verses.en_bbe: And Jacob said to his people, Get stones together; and they did so; and they had a meal there by the stones.

verses.en: And Laban called it Jegar-sahadutha: but Jacob called it Galeed.
verses.pt: E Labão o chamou Jegar-Saaduta; e Jacó o chamou Galeede.
verses.en_web: Laban called it Jegar Sahadutha, but Jacob called it Galeed.
verses.en_bbe: And the name Laban gave it was Jegar-sahadutha: but Jacob gave it the name of Galeed.

verses.en: And Laban said, This heap is a witness between me and thee this day. Therefore was the name of it called Galeed;
verses.pt: Porque Labão disse: Este amontoado é testemunha hoje entre mim e entre ti; por isso foi chamado seu nome Galeede.
verses.en_web: Laban said, “This heap is witness between me and you today.” Therefore it was named Galeed
verses.en_bbe: And Laban said, These stones are a witness between you and me today. For this reason its name was Galeed,

verses.en: And Mizpah; for he said, The LORD watch between me and thee, when we are absent one from another.
verses.pt: E Mispá, porquanto disse: Vigie o SENHOR entre mim e entre ti, quando nos separarmos um do outro.
verses.en_web: and Mizpah, for he said, “Yahweh watch between me and you, when we are absent one from another.
verses.en_bbe: And Mizpah, for he said, May the Lord keep watch on us when we are unable to see one another's doings.

verses.en: If thou shalt afflict my daughters, or if thou shalt take other wives beside my daughters, no man is with us; see, God is witness betwixt me and thee.
verses.pt: Se afligires minhas filhas, ou se tomares outras mulheres além de minhas filhas, ninguém está conosco; olha, Deus é testemunha entre mim e ti.
verses.en_web: If you afflict my daughters, or if you take wives besides my daughters, no man is with us; behold, God is witness between me and you.”
verses.en_bbe: If you are cruel to my daughters, or if you take other wives in addition to my daughters, then though no man is there to see, God will be the witness between us.

verses.en: And Laban said to Jacob, Behold this heap, and behold this pillar, which I have cast betwixt me and thee;
verses.pt: Disse mais Labão a Jacó: Eis que este amontoado, e eis que esta coluna, que erigi entre mim e ti.
verses.en_web: Laban said to Jacob, “See this heap, and see the pillar, which I have set between me and you.
verses.en_bbe: And Laban said, See these stones and this pillar which I have put between you and me;

verses.en: This heap be witness, and this pillar be witness, that I will not pass over this heap to thee, and that thou shalt not pass over this heap and this pillar unto me, for harm.
verses.pt: Testemunha seja este amontoado, e testemunha seja esta coluna, que nem eu passarei contra ti este amontoado, nem tu passarás contra mim este amontoado nem esta coluna, para o mal.
verses.en_web: May this heap be a witness, and the pillar be a witness, that I will not pass over this heap to you, and that you will not pass over this heap and this pillar to me, for harm.
verses.en_bbe: They will be witness that I will not go over these stones to you, and you will not go over these stones or this pillar to me, for any evil purpose.

verses.en: The God of Abraham, and the God of Nahor, the God of their father, judge betwixt us. And Jacob sware by the fear of his father Isaac.
verses.pt: O Deus de Abraão, e o Deus de Naor julgue entre nós, o Deus de seus pais. E Jacó jurou pelo temor de Isaque seu pai.
verses.en_web: The God of Abraham, and the God of Nahor, the God of their father, judge between us.” Then Jacob swore by the fear of his father, Isaac.
verses.en_bbe: May the God of Abraham and the God of Nahor, the God of their father, be our judge. Then Jacob took an oath by the Fear of his father Isaac.

verses.en: Then Jacob offered sacrifice upon the mount, and called his brethren to eat bread: and they did eat bread, and tarried all night in the mount.
verses.pt: Então Jacó ofereceu sacrifícios no monte, e chamou seus parentes para comer pão; e comeram pão, e dormiram aquela noite no monte.
verses.en_web: Jacob offered a sacrifice in the mountain, and called his relatives to eat bread. They ate bread, and stayed all night in the mountain.
verses.en_bbe: And Jacob made an offering on the mountain, and gave orders to his people to take food: so they had a meal and took their rest that night on the mountain.

verses.en: And early in the morning Laban rose up, and kissed his sons and his daughters, and blessed them: and Laban departed, and returned unto his place.
verses.pt: E levantou-se Labão de manhã, beijou seus filhos e suas filhas, e os abençoou; e retrocedeu e voltou a seu lugar.
verses.en_web: Early in the morning, Laban rose up, and kissed his sons and his daughters, and blessed them. Laban departed and returned to his place.
verses.en_bbe: And early in the morning Laban, after kissing and blessing his daughters, went on his way back to his country.
